KeysToEntries.TelemetryBody:
Jagex will always collect information that is necessary for legal compliance, to keep our game safe and secure, to prevent and detect fraud and technical faults and for similar necessary purposes. 
With your consent, we would like to collect additional information about your device using a player activity plugin. This additional information allows our team to review how players use systems and play the game to expand on old systems or add new features to help us make better decisions about the future of our game. If you choose, we will also use this information to offer you a better and personalised advertising experience. 
You can change your mind at any time.
